input.quote: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
input.rationale: Article XIII caps only Licensor's liability, at one half of amounts paid, with no corresponding cap on Licensee; Licensee's liability is therefore unlimited and is further expanded by the broad one-way indemnity in Article XII (p0128–p0129). The consequential-damages exclusion in (a) also runs only in Licensor's favour, and there are no carve-outs for confidentiality, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud or IP infringement. This is walk-away territory under the rule (customer uncapped while vendor is capped; vendor cap below six months' fees; indemnities effectively inside no cap at all), so it fails the fallback. Redline makes the cap and damages exclusion mutual, resets the cap to the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, adds the Excluded Claims carve-out and confirms our payment obligations are not capped damages. A mutual 12-month fee cap with indemnity/confidentiality/gross negligence/wilful misconduct carve-outs is the acceptable fallback.

proposal.summary: Make the liability cap and damages exclusion mutual, reset the cap to the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, and carve out Excluded Claims.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the cap and the consequential-damages exclusion mutual and reset the cap to the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000, since as drafted only Licensor is capped (at one half of all amounts paid) while our liability is unlimited. Indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and our payment obligations are not capped damages; a mutual 12-month fee cap is our fallback if USD 1,000,000 is not workable.

ops.newText: (a) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY OR TO ANY THIRD PARTY FOR ANY SPECIAL

ops.oldText: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
ops.newText: (b) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (I) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY LICENSEE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (II) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. LICENSEE'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THE FOREGOING CAP.
